notes: My own solve: successive minima (troughs) of a travelling wave are one full wavelength apart, so λ = 2.7 m. Five crests in 15.0 s gives f = 5/15 = 1/3 Hz, and v = fλ = 0.9 m/s — option 1, the solution's answer. All three step equations are true. The common_mistakes entry is the right one for this question (the 4-gaps-versus-5-crests ambiguity) and its arithmetic checks out: (4/15) × 2.7 = 0.72 m/s, which indeed matches no printed option, so option null is correct.
